sections.heading: Business
sections.markdown: Communication Services / Telecom Services · Indonesia. PT Solusi Sinergi Digital Tbk engages in the advertising businesses in Indonesia. It provides connectivity solutions, such as leases core and leased line; and colocation data center, content delivery network, and tower fiberization services. The company also offers development technology ecosystems, including mobile applications, such as KAI access and DAMRI for ticketing services, Adakita, and MyVerse, Sobat Tani applications; advertising and media; and IT solutions.
